somerville.name: Somerville Lake
verdict: permit
Limited: waterfowl in marked areas, hogs by permit
Deer hunting is prohibited on Corps land here except on the TPWD WMA (Somerville PHL) and the December challenged-hunter hunt.
rules: Prohibited at Somerville Lake except the Annual Challenged Hunter Deer Hunt in December (Somerville Lake Office) and the TPWD Wildlife Management Area ((979) 540-6837).
By permit only: bowhunting, live-trapping, shotgun and dogs, through the Hunt Coordinator at the lake office (compartment drawing).
Daytime only, inside the yellow markers, never outside the red markers. Hunt from the shoreline. Temporary blinds must be removed when you leave.
Assigned for the whole season by random drawing on Recreation.gov.
The area near Harge Rd parking lot extending to and across Flag Pond Rd is closed to waterfowl hunting.
Hunter education, a Texas hunting license, and all federal, state and local rules.
somerville.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers lake hunting page (Fort Worth District Hunting Guide 2026-27)

granger.name: Granger Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable on the WMA with the APH permit
The 10,800+ acre WMA is part of TPWD's APH and drawing programs.
rules: 10,800+ acres of Wildlife Management Area, run through TPWD's Annual Public Hunting permit and drawings.
Archery only, through TPWD's e-Postcard drawing.
granger.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers lake hunting page (Fort Worth District Hunting Guide 2026-27)

belton.name: Belton Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable in designated areas with strict method limits
Shotgun (#2 shot or smaller) and archery only; deer by lottery permit; no turkey.
rules: Feral hog, white-tailed deer (permit only), dove, quail, rails, snipe, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl. Small game and waterfowl Sept 1 – Mar 31 as TPWD allows.
Archery only, by lottery permit (Recreation.gov 'Belton Lake Archery Deer Hunt Permits' or the lake office).
Archery only, daylight, year-round except during the permitted deer season; no dogs.
Archery for hogs and deer; shotguns for everything else. Muzzleloaders, rifles, pistols, slugs and shot larger than #2 are prohibited at all times.
Daylight only in designated areas on the lake maps. No firearms within 600 ft (archery 100 ft) of boundaries, parks, roads, piers, outlets or spillways, or within 600 ft of private property.
On land only in designated WMAs; on water under TPWD rules and the spacing distances.
Portable stands and ground blinds only, no bark penetration; remove at the end of each day.
400 sq in with orange headgear, 144 sq in front and back (waterfowl hunters exempt once set up).
Turkey, furbearers, predators (bobcat, coyote, lions, raptors), night hunting, spotlighting, trapping, target practice, feeders, electronic calls. Baiting only for permitted deer hunters.
Retrieving birds per TPWD; rabbit and squirrel dogs need a lake activity permit, max 6 dogs with GPS collars, handler in orange.
Hunter education, Texas license and stamps. APH permit not required.
belton.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers lake hunting page (Fort Worth District Hunting Guide 2026-27)

stillhouse.name: Stillhouse Hollow Lake
verdict: permit
Dove, waterfowl and quail only
Free public hunting in designated areas; deer and turkey prohibited.
rules: Dove, waterfowl and quail only. Deer, turkey, furbearers, non-game and predators prohibited.
Sept 1 through the end of goose season.
Shotgun with shot only; steel or approved non-toxic shot for waterfowl. No rifles, pistols, buckshot or slugs; no target practice.
Designated hunting areas (WMAs on the lake map) and adjacent waters only; not within 600 ft of private property or recreation areas.
Temporary or natural blinds; remove temporary blinds at the end of each day.
Blaze orange required in hunting areas. No Corps waterfowl permit needed. No traps, snares, bait or tranquilizers. Vehicles on designated roads only; camp in designated parks.
stillhouse.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers lake hunting page (Fort Worth District Hunting Guide 2026-27)

waco.name: Waco Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable with a $15 Waco Lake permit
Required for everyone, any game; shotgun and archery only.
rules: $15 Waco Lake hunting permit on Recreation.gov (on sale Sept 1), required for all hunters 17+; ages 13 – 16 with a permit holder; 12 and under may not hunt. Max 2 vehicles per permit; carry the printed permit.
Dove, squirrel, rabbits, feral hogs, waterfowl, coyote and deer.
Deer, coyote and hogs: archery only (crossbows OK). Birds and small game: non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. No slugs, sabots, #1, B, BB, BBB or buckshot, no rifles, pistols or muzzleloaders.
Per the Outdoor Annual for McLennan County. Small game, coyotes and hogs any time except during an open deer season. Deer archery only in every season. No night hunting.
Waterfowl only in the northern and southern zones. No hunting around Waco Wetlands.
Portable non-bark-penetrating stands, cameras and ground blinds may stay out if tagged with name, phone and date; tags good 7 days.
Baiting by hand-spreading only. No sport-chasing, no target practice or sighting in. Hog trapping by permit only.
waco.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers lake hunting page (Fort Worth District Hunting Guide 2026-27)

whitney.name: Whitney Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable with a Whitney/Aquilla Corps permit
Recreation.gov permit for hunters 17+; deer and hogs archery only.
rules: Hunters 17+ buy a permit on Recreation.gov, good for all authorized game and seasons at both Whitney and Aquilla lakes (Sept-Aug, with the Texas license year). Ages 12-16 hunt with a permitted adult without a permit; 12 and under may come along but not hunt.
Dove, squirrel, rabbit, waterfowl, turkey, feral hog and deer.
Texas Outdoor Annual for Bosque and Hill counties.
Deer and feral hog: archery only (crossbows OK). Other game: shotgun with non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. No #1, B, BB, BBB, buckshot, slugs or sabots; no rifles, handguns or muzzleloaders.
Portable, non-bark-penetrating tree stands only, removed after each hunt.
No sport chasing, trapping or snaring, night hunting (30 min after sunset to 30 min before sunrise), target practice or sighting in.
whitney.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

aquilla.name: Aquilla Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable with a Whitney/Aquilla Corps permit
Recreation.gov permit for hunters 17+; deer and hogs archery only.
rules: Hunters 17+ buy a permit on Recreation.gov, good for all authorized game and seasons at both Whitney and Aquilla lakes (Sept-Aug, with the Texas license year). Ages 12-16 hunt with a permitted adult without a permit; 12 and under may come along but not hunt.
Dove, squirrel, rabbit, waterfowl, turkey, feral hog and deer.
Texas Outdoor Annual for Hill County.
Deer and feral hog: archery only (crossbows OK). Other game: shotgun with non-toxic #2 shot or smaller. No #1, B, BB, BBB, buckshot, slugs or sabots; no rifles, handguns or muzzleloaders.
Portable, non-bark-penetrating tree stands only, removed after each hunt.
No sport chasing, trapping or snaring, night hunting (30 min after sunset to 30 min before sunrise), target practice or sighting in.
aquilla.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

bardwell.name: Bardwell Lake
verdict: yes
Huntable, no Corps permit
Dove, small game, waterfowl and hogs in mapped areas; no rifles.
rules: Dove, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl, snipe, rails and feral hogs, per the Outdoor Annual for Ellis County. No deer.
Archery (crossbows OK). Shotgun: non-toxic #2 or smaller for birds and small game; slugs only for hogs. No #1-BBB or buckshot; no rifles, handguns or muzzleloaders.

Only in areas marked on the Bardwell hunting map. Feral hogs only north of SH 34, archery or slug shotgun. No firearm within 600 ft, or archery within 100 ft, of a boundary line, developed park, road, fishing pier, outlet structure or spillway unless posted otherwise.
No dogs for hogs; no night hunting.
bardwell.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

georgetown.name: Lake Georgetown
verdict: permit
Drawn permits only
Archery deer/hog and small game/waterfowl permits are lottery draws on Recreation.gov.
rules: Archery deer and hog: apply on Recreation.gov in June ($10 application); if drawn, $100 permit, an archery proficiency test (80%+, IBO course, max 30 yd, dated May 1 or later), hunter education and the mandatory orientation (Aug 15, 2026). Small game and waterfowl: lottery on Recreation.gov in July ($10 application plus $15 permit). Ages 9-16 with a guardian.
Dove, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl, deer (TPWD MLDP tags) and feral hogs.
Sept 27 - Jan 11 only, within the Williamson County seasons. Everything except archery is closed during archery deer season; all hunting closed from the end of February until dove season.
Deer and hogs archery only; small game and waterfowl shotgun only, non-toxic #2 or smaller. No #1-BBB, buckshot, slugs, rifles, pistols or muzzleloaders.

Hunt Hollow WMA (1,200 ac) for small game and archery permit holders, plus archery-only areas. Walk in from parks and access points; no driving to hunt spots. One location per hunter; no stalking or still hunting.
Blinds tagged with your permit number, set up only after you get your permit; unmarked blinds are removed.
georgetown.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

navarro.name: Navarro Mills Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable; deer need a Corps permit
Deer archery only by permit; other game under state rules.
rules: Free archery deer permit: apply Aug 1 - Sept 18, 2026 (digital permit by email); carry proof on the property. Post-season survey due May 31, 2027 or you lose next year's permit. No permit for other game.
Deer, dove, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl and feral hog; bag limits per TPWD for Hill and Navarro counties.
Deer archery only. Hogs: archery only during any open deer season; slug shotgun outside deer seasons. Other game non-toxic #2 or smaller. No #1-BBB, buckshot, rifles, pistols or muzzleloaders.
The WMA between Wolf Creek and Brushie Prairie Park is closed to all hunting. No target shooting on government land.
Portable non-bark-penetrating stands marked with name, address, phone and date; all property removed within 72 hours. Bait by hand only during your permit period; no feeders or electronic calls.
Dogs for hogs only outside deer seasons, in daylight. No sport chasing or spotlighting. Hog trapping by limited permit.
navarro.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

lewisville.name: Lewisville Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable with a Lewisville Corps permit
600 permits a year; shotgun #2 or smaller, hogs and coyotes archery only.
rules: General hunting permit (600, first come first served; 2026-27 sold out). Each permit holder may bring one guest 18+; 17 and under hunt with a permitted adult. Needs a hunter ed certificate (no deferrals) and a Texas license. Archery deer in the Hickory Creek area by lottery (July), with a mandatory pre-hunt meeting.
Deer (permit hunt only), dove, quail, squirrel, rabbit, snipe, rails, feral hogs, waterfowl, turkey and coyotes, per the Outdoor Annual for Denton County. Areas open Sept 1, 2026 - Aug 31, 2027.
Hogs and coyotes archery only (crossbows OK). Other game shotgun, #2 shot or smaller. No rifles, pistols or muzzleloaders, even to carry.

No firearm within 600 ft, or archery within 100 ft, of a boundary line, developed park, road, fishing pier, outlet structure or spillway unless posted otherwise. North of Highway 380 is leased to the City of Denton, which runs hunting there (940-349-8230). No vehicles off designated roads.
Non-bark-penetrating tree stands and temporary free-standing blinds, removed at the end of each day.
400 sq in of hunter orange plus orange headwear (not for turkey, waterfowl or migratory birds).
lewisville.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

lavon.name: Lavon Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable with a Lavon permit; no deer
Permit for every species; deer hunting is closed.
rules: All hunters 17+ need a Lavon permit (new hunters at the office Aug 15 - Nov 15, 2026; returning hunters at lavonlakehunting.tamu.edu). Hunter ed required, no deferrals. 16 and under with a permitted adult.
Dove, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl (hunting areas 1-14 only), snipe and feral hog. Deer hunting is illegal on Lavon Corps land until further notice.

Archery in all areas; slug shotgun also in areas 6-13. Allowed 24 hours, but no spotlighting. No hog hunting during Collin County archery and general deer seasons (Oct 1, 2026 - Jan 19, 2027). No dogs for hogs.
Shotgun #2 or smaller; non-toxic for waterfowl. No rifles, handguns, air guns or muzzleloaders. Unload when moving between sites.

No firearm within 600 ft, or archery within 100 ft, of a boundary line, developed park, road, fishing pier, outlet structure or spillway unless posted otherwise. Don't set up within 250 ft of another hunter. No vehicles in hunting areas.
No trapping or baiting. Hunter orange at all times (waterfowl and migratory bird hunters exempt once set up). Dogs OK for rabbits, squirrels and birds (max 6, GPS collars).
lavon.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

grapevine.name: Grapevine Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable with a Grapevine Corps permit
Deer and waterfowl by lottery; general permit for other game.
rules: Archery deer: 250 permits by lottery, apply July (email preferred); deer permit holders may also take hogs during deer season. Waterfowl: 500 by lottery, apply July 1-31. General: 800 first come first served from Aug 15 for other Denton County game. Youth 16 and under archery deer without a permit but with a signed waiver. Post-season survey due Mar 1.
Archery deer and youth deer Oct 3 - Jan 17. Waterfowl shooting ends at noon. Others per the Outdoor Annual for Denton County.
Deer and hogs archery only (crossbows OK). Other game shotgun, #2 or smaller. No muzzleloaders, rifles or pistols to hunt with or carry.
Shore hunting in the general waterfowl area; watercraft-only zone means no shore hunting. Stay 600 ft from homes, parks (incl. Trophy Club Park and its shoreline), roads and farm yards.
Portable non-bark-penetrating or free-standing stands, removed at the end of each day.
No baiting of any kind, and no varmint calls, baits or lures while hunting (decoys OK). No target shooting, night hunting, trapping or sport chasing.
grapevine.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

benbrook.name: Benbrook Lake
verdict: permit
Drawn 2-week Corps permits
Every hunter needs a Benbrook permit; deer, hog and turkey archery only.
rules: Lottery in August for each 2-week period (once per season); a listed partner gets a permit too. Mail license, hunter ed card, signed waiver and driver's license copy to the lake office. Permits valid Sept 15 - Jan 31. Activity survey due Mar 1.
Dove, quail, turkey, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl, deer and feral hogs (Tarrant County seasons). No furbearers or non-game.
Deer, hog and turkey archery only (crossbows OK). Other game shotgun, non-toxic #2 or smaller. No slugs, buckshot, rifles, handguns, air rifles or muzzleloaders. Unload when moving.
About 1,400 ac. No access from Longhorn Park; don't cross Southwest Christian School property. No hunting within 600 ft of homes, roads, piers, outlet works, farm yards or park boundaries.

Portable non-bark-penetrating stands and portable or loose-material blinds tagged with name, date, address and phone; removed after each 2-week permit. No feeders; hand-scattered corn and feed blocks OK (never for migratory birds).
No dogs for hunting, trapping, camping in hunt areas, off-road vehicles or target practice. Park only at designated access points.
benbrook.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

proctor.name: Proctor Lake
verdict: permit
Huntable with a free Proctor permit
Waterfowl, dove, squirrel, rabbit and hogs only; no deer or turkey.
rules: Free yearly permit (17+) from the lake office in person or by mail; covers you and up to 2 guests in the Sabana and Upper Leon WMAs and Rush Creek Hunting Area. Waterfowl on the designated main-lake areas needs no permit.
Waterfowl, dove, squirrel, rabbit and feral hog (Comanche County seasons). Deer, turkey, bobcat and quail are prohibited.
Archery incl. crossbows; shotgun with non-toxic #2 or smaller. No slugs, buckshot, rifles, pistols or muzzleloaders.
Non-bark-penetrating stands and pop-up blinds removed daily; don't cut vegetation. Hand-broadcast hog bait only outside migratory bird seasons.
No motor vehicles in hunting areas (bikes OK). Dogs only to retrieve birds. No target shooting.
proctor.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

hords.name: Hords Creek Lake
verdict: no
Closed to public hunting
Hunting only at Corps events for disadvantaged youth.
rules: Closed to public hunting; bowfishing also prohibited.
hords.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

joepool.name: Joe Pool Lake
verdict: no
No hunting allowed
The Corps has closed Joe Pool Lake to hunting.
rules: Closed to hunting. Dog field trials may be allowed by special event permit.
joepool.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

canyon.name: Canyon Lake
verdict: no
No hunting allowed
Canyon Lake doesn't allow any hunting.
rules: Closed to hunting (little land and nearby neighborhoods).
canyon.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

rayburn.name: Sam Rayburn Reservoir
verdict: yes
Huntable, no Corps permit; no rifles or pistols
State seasons apply on the strip of Corps land around the lake.
rules: As in the Outdoor Annual for Angelina, Jasper, Nacogdoches, San Augustine and Sabine counties.

No centerfire or rimfire rifles or pistols. Muzzleloaders in general and muzzleloader seasons. Slugs/sabots for deer and hogs in the general season; other game non-toxic #2 or smaller; no buckshot or #1-BBB.
Not within 600 ft of a residence, private structure, campground or leased facility; not over roads or trails or in recreation areas. Vehicles only on designated roads.
Portable non-bark-penetrating, max 72 hours, marked with name, address, phone and date.

No baiting for any species. Hunter orange (400 sq in plus headwear) except archery-season, squirrel and bird hunters. No night hunting, traps or snares. Dogs for hogs only outside deer seasons, daylight only. Camp and build fires only in designated areas.
rayburn.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

steinhagen.name: B.A. Steinhagen Lake (Town Bluff)
verdict: permit
Huntable with a Corps permit; no rifles
Corps land: shotgun, muzzleloader and archery only; no baiting.
rules: Corps permit required on the Corps-managed land (feral hog permits for out-of-season areas from the lake office in person, Mon-Fri).
Dove, quail, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl, deer and feral hogs; alligators only in TPWD drawn hunts.
No rifles or pistols. Archery and muzzleloaders OK. Slugs/sabots for deer and hogs in the general season; no buckshot. Birds and small game non-toxic #2 or smaller.

Jasper and Tyler county seasons. Antlerless deer in archery-only and muzzleloader-only seasons (youth in youth seasons). Hogs only during deer season, except year-round with a permit in areas south of Hwy 190 and north of Camper's Cove.

No baiting of any species; no ATVs. Stands portable, max 72 hours, labeled. Hunter orange rules apply. No firearm within 600 ft, or archery within 100 ft, of a boundary line, developed park, road, fishing pier, outlet structure or spillway unless posted otherwise.
The Angelina-Neches/Dam B WMA (TPWD unit 707) has its own TPWD rules; rimfire and centerfire are allowed there.
steinhagen.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

townbluff.name: B.A. Steinhagen Lake (Town Bluff)
verdict: permit
Huntable with a Corps permit; no rifles
Corps land: shotgun, muzzleloader and archery only; no baiting.
rules: Corps permit required on the Corps-managed land (feral hog permits for out-of-season areas from the lake office in person, Mon-Fri).
Dove, quail, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl, deer and feral hogs; alligators only in TPWD drawn hunts.
No rifles or pistols. Archery and muzzleloaders OK. Slugs/sabots for deer and hogs in the general season; no buckshot. Birds and small game non-toxic #2 or smaller.

Jasper and Tyler county seasons. Antlerless deer in archery-only and muzzleloader-only seasons (youth in youth seasons). Hogs only during deer season, except year-round with a permit in areas south of Hwy 190 and north of Camper's Cove.

No baiting of any species; no ATVs. Stands portable, max 72 hours, labeled. Hunter orange rules apply. No firearm within 600 ft, or archery within 100 ft, of a boundary line, developed park, road, fishing pier, outlet structure or spillway unless posted otherwise.
The Angelina-Neches/Dam B WMA (TPWD unit 707) has its own TPWD rules; rimfire and centerfire are allowed there.
townbluff.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

patman.name: Wright Patman Lake
verdict: yes
Huntable, no permit (ATV areas need a $20 permit)
State seasons; rifles OK west of US 59.
rules: No hunting permit. ATV/UTV use only in the Clear Springs and Big Creek WMAs with a $20 permit (one per season; archery, rifle 1, rifle 2) from the Clear Springs Park gate house, from Sept 12, 2026, with an ATV safety certificate.
Dove, squirrel, rabbits, waterfowl, feral hog, woodcock and white-tailed deer. No eastern turkey hunting.
Rifles everywhere except east of US 59, where deer and hogs are slug shotgun or archery only. Muzzleloaders OK; no pistols. Birds and small game non-toxic #2 or smaller; no buckshot.

No hunting within 600 ft of homes, parks, roads, piers, livestock pens, the outlet or spillway, or posted areas (maps at the project office and gate houses). Most access roads closed to vehicles Jan 15 - Sept 15.
Portable non-bark-penetrating stands, max 72 hours, labeled, 300 ft from trails and roads. Corn for deer and hogs by hand or small bucket feeders.
Hunter orange (400 sq in plus headwear) except archery, squirrel and bird hunters. Nutria with #4-#2 non-toxic shot or archery with a retrieval line.
patman.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

pines.name: Lake O' the Pines
verdict: yes
Huntable, no Corps permit
State seasons; rifles only in two areas.
rules: As in the Outdoor Annual for Camp, Harrison, Marion, Morris and Upshur counties. All hunting closed June 1 - Aug 31.

Rifles for deer and hogs only south of the dam and west of Cypress Creek, and north of Hwy 155; elsewhere slug shotgun, muzzleloader or archery. No pistols or air rifles. Shot non-toxic #2 or smaller; no buckshot.

No baiting. Stands portable, max 72 hours, labeled. No dogs or night hunting for hogs. Hunter orange rules apply. ATV permits only for permanent ambulatory disability (south of the dam). No firearm within 600 ft, or archery within 100 ft, of a boundary line, developed park, road, fishing pier, outlet structure or spillway unless posted otherwise.
pines.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

cooper.name: Cooper Lake (Jim Chapman)
verdict: permit
TPWD-run WMA: APH permit
Corps land here is the Cooper WMA, run by TPWD.
rules: Hunting lands are licensed to TPWD (Cooper WMA, ~9,460 ac, Delta and Hopkins counties). Day use only; register at designated access points. Tap inside the WMA for its TPWD unit rules.
cooper.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

fisher.name: O.C. Fisher Lake
verdict: check
Run by TPWD or Angelo State University
Hunting lands are licensed out; rules depend on which part you're on.
rules: Licensed to TPWD through San Angelo State Park (tap inside the park for its unit rules).
4,645 ac run by Angelo State University: deer, turkey and javelina by public drawing for three hunts a year; fee and ASU permit required (325-942-2027).
fisher.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page

rayroberts.name: Ray Roberts Lake
verdict: permit
TPWD public hunting land: APH permit
Corps land here is licensed to TPWD (Ray Roberts PHL, unit 501).
rules: Public hunting lands are run by TPWD under a Corps license; day use only, no entrance fee. You need the $48 Annual Public Hunting permit.
Feral hogs, dove, quail, woodcock, gallinules, rails, snipe, waterfowl, frogs, rabbits, hares and squirrels.
Enter only at TPWD-designated access points. The waterfowl sanctuary on the northwest side is closed to waterfowl hunting. Tap inside the unit for TPWD's full unit 501 rules.
rayroberts.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fort Worth District Public Hunting Guide 2026-27 and the lake's hunting page
